dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Nineteen public datasets were pooled for normative model training (80%/20% train-test splits), with only controls from ADNI3, OASIS3, PPMI, and HBN. ADNI3 and OASIS3 patient groups were used for anomaly detection. NIMHANS and UCLA were used for model adaptation, using 50% controls for recalibration and the remaining controls plus patients for anomaly detection.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Several clinical datasets were also included in the analyses: ... ADNI3 ... OASIS3 ... PPMI ... and the Healthy Brain Network (HBN) ... only the healthy controls (HC) of the latter four datasets were added to the pool of training data to build the normative models... In contrast, the patients in ADNI3 and OASIS3 were included as test data for the anomaly detection experiment." ... "Two additional datasets were used for the model adaptation experiments: ... NIMHANS ... and ... UCLA" ... "we took 50% of the healthy control subjects from the new sites to adapt the parameters of the reference model. Then the Z-scores for the remaining 50% healthy controls and the cases of the new incorporated sites are computed"

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Training/testing used 80%/20% splits of the 54,583 total participants; 10 repetitions were run with 80% splits (n=43,666).
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "Training and testing data sets were created with an 80% to 20% sample split, stratified by site, based on the total number of 54,583 participants... we ran HBR 10 times on each of the 80% sample splits (n=43,666)."
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: VillalonReina2024.pdf.md: Methods / Training and testing data sets
